knowledge_changes: Updated .codewiki/kb/system/compilers.md planning-loop propagation contract to reject build-only deferral for executable rows.
Updated .codewiki/kb/system/validation-gateway.md planning/close validation rules to block accepted executable rows without task/sprint mapping.
Updated .codewiki/kb/system/roadmap.md to make roadmap/sprint mapping the durable scheduling mechanism for approved executable rows.
Updated .codewiki/kb/system/graph.md to include unmapped accepted-decision gaps in Work lens responsibility.

row_to_kb_mappings.evidence: Compilers and validation gateway now state every approved row needs durable planning disposition before downstream consumption.
Docs now make task/sprint mapping mandatory for executable rows and assign sequencing to roadmap order/status/dependencies/blockers/sprints.
Roadmap and graph docs now require generated state to expose unmapped accepted-decision gaps for routing.
Validation gateway and compiler docs now require fail/block when accepted executable rows lack durable task/sprint mapping.

product_impact: Users and agents get safer continuation because approved decisions cannot be lost outside roadmap/sprint/KB disposition.
system_impact: Planning compiler, graph/read models, resume routing, and validation gateway must enforce unplanned accepted-decision gaps.
downstream_planning_questions: Plan executable enforcement for build/graph/gateway/resume/audit so accepted executable rows without task/sprint mapping become blockers.

Plan migration/repair for existing accepted build-only deferred rows, including daemon execution graph / worker dispatch follow-up, by promoting them into roadmap/sprint tasks or explicit durable non-execution dispositions.
Implement compiler/gateway/state enforcement so accepted executable decision rows cannot remain only in builds without task/sprint mapping.
Repair existing build-only deferred accepted rows by creating/updating roadmap/sprint work or durable non-execution dispositions, starting with daemon execution graph / worker dispatch follow-up.
Plan executable enforcement for build/graph/gateway/resume/audit so accepted executable rows without task/sprint mapping become blockers.

assumptions: Roadmap task order, task status, blockers, dependencies, and sprint metadata are the durable scheduling surface for executable work.
Non-executable or blocked rows may be resolved without an implementation task only when durable KB/roadmap disposition evidence exists.
non_goals: Do not implement full daemon worker spawning in this decision loop.
Do not replace planning builds, roadmap tasks, validation reports, or Git/content proof.
Do not require every knowledge-only row to create a task.
risks: Existing accepted builds may contain deferred rows that need migration or explicit durable disposition.
